distribution.summary: 四川；贵州；云南；台湾；香港
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) supports occurrence in 四川, 贵州 and 云南. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds a first Taiwan record based on more than 50 specimens from Chiayi, Hsinchu, Kaohsiung, Kinmen, Nantou, Taipei, Taichung and Taitung. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: The exact host taxa currently promoted are retained from 黄复生等 (2015). Beaver & Liu (2010) describes use of twigs and small branches of many angiosperm trees and shrubs but does not enumerate additional host taxa in this Source Record; that broad prose is preserved as context rather than split into inferred taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus birmanus (Eichhoff, 1878).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus birmanus (Eichhoff, 1878), VSN_3182. 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) preserve authorship (Eichhoff). A previous profile record gave authorship Chapuis, 1869 was inconsistent with the canonical integrated taxonomic backbone identity and is not used for the current accepted authorship.
